title: Sail Sand Point

services.name: Learn To Sail
services.desc: Join us for a day of fun on a sailboat at our Adaptive Sailing Day on August 22nd from 1-4PM! We are hosting free sailing sessions for people who have disabilities and their friends/families. If you have ever been interested in getting out on the water and want to try it out or have a fun evening with friends, join us for a sail and barbecue! We will be taking out the J24, RS Venture and other dinghy sailboats. While the RS VEnture has rigid seats, we have structured stadium seats we can add to the other boats if more support is preferred. Reference the photos below if you are curious about how this can be set up. If you are interested in coming, please fill out the Adaptive Sailing Day
